title: rosa pouzinii var. typica
intro: Rosa pouzinii var. typica, commonly known as the Alpine Rose, is a type of rose species native to the mountainous regions of Europe. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including inflammation, pain, and infections due to its health benefits in reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Rosa pouzinii var. typica include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
